Passed 2025-08-15. Reading generated by ollama:deepseek-v4-pro from the enrolled text; the full text is at the foot of this page so every statement can be checked against it. LegiScan record · official text

What it does

This law requires each community college board to ensure that a course is taught by a human faculty member who meets certain qualifications. It prohibits a course from using artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction in place of a faculty member. It clarifies that a faculty member may use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction.

Who it applies to

  • Each board under the Public Community College Act
  • Faculty members who teach courses at a public community college

Effective date

not stated in the text

Key definitions

  • artificial intelligence: has the same meaning given to the term in Section 2-101 of the Illinois Human Rights Act (Sec. 3-29.28(a))

Obligations

  • Each board shall require the faculty member who teaches a course to be an individual who meets the qualifications set forth in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and any other applicable rules adopted by the State Board (Sec. 3-29.28(b))

Prohibitions

  • A course may not, in lieu of a faculty member, use artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction for students (Sec. 3-29.28(b))

Penalties and enforcement

not stated in the text

How it affects AI deployment

  • A community college board must ensure that any course is taught by a qualified human faculty member, not solely by artificial intelligence (Sec. 3-29.28(b))
  • A faculty member may use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction, so AI tools can be deployed as a supplement but not as the sole instructor (Sec. 3-29.28(c))

Notable exemptions

  • Use of artificial intelligence by a faculty member to augment course instruction is not prohibited (Sec. 3-29.28(c))

Compliance steps

  • Confirm that every course has a faculty member who is an individual and meets the qualifications in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and any other applicable State Board rules
  • Do not use artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction for any course in place of a faculty member
  • Permit faculty members to use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction if they choose
